headline: Preparations to make electricity more expensive for consumers nationwide
summary: An application has been filed to raise electricity prices by 1 rupee 73 paisa per unit under the monthly fuel adjustment, according to the report. The Central Power Purchasing Agency is involved.
why: Electricity tariffs affect household budgets, industrial costs and inflation, and are set under state regulation in Pakistan.
